title: Notification settings revert after page refresh
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in PrefsKit, the user encountered: Notification settings revert after page refresh.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Settings
2. Observe UI state: Saved
3. Observe UI state: Email alerts

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Email alerts.

## Environment
- App: PrefsKit
- Platform: web
